# Sparrow

> Sparrow provides Minecraft server administration commands, portable workstations, item editing, and configurable player features.

Every link below points to the Markdown version of that page. All pages combined into one file: [llms-full.txt](https://nanamoserver.github.io/sparrow-wiki/llms-full.txt).

简体中文: [llms.txt](https://nanamoserver.github.io/sparrow-wiki/zh-Hans/llms.txt)

- [Introduction](https://nanamoserver.github.io/sparrow-wiki/index.md): Sparrow provides everyday administration commands, homes, warps, teleport requests, random teleportation and custom death messages for Paper and Folia.
- [Commands and permissions](https://nanamoserver.github.io/sparrow-wiki/commands.md): <argument> is required; [argument] is optional. These are the default entry points and permissions. Short commands also accept /sparrow <command> or /spr <command>. Restart after editing commands.yml.

## Features

- [Quick shulker](https://nanamoserver.github.io/sparrow-wiki/features/quick-shulker.md): Module quick-shulker · Configuration features/quick-shulker.yml
- [Elevators](https://nanamoserver.github.io/sparrow-wiki/features/elevator.md): Module elevator · Configuration features/elevator.yaml
- [Patrol](https://nanamoserver.github.io/sparrow-wiki/features/patrol.md): Module patrol · Configuration features/patrol.yml
- [Heads](https://nanamoserver.github.io/sparrow-wiki/features/head.md): Module head · Configuration features/head.yml
- [Maintenance](https://nanamoserver.github.io/sparrow-wiki/features/maintenance.md): Module maintenance · Configuration features/maintenance.yml
- [Online time](https://nanamoserver.github.io/sparrow-wiki/features/online-time.md): Module online_time · Configuration features/online_time.yml
- [Player limit](https://nanamoserver.github.io/sparrow-wiki/features/player-limit.md): Module player_limit · Configuration features/player_limit.yml
- [Death messages](https://nanamoserver.github.io/sparrow-wiki/features/death-messages.md): Module death_messages · Configuration features/death_messages.yml
- [Bans](https://nanamoserver.github.io/sparrow-wiki/features/ban.md): Module ban · Configuration features/ban.yml
- [Back and death back](https://nanamoserver.github.io/sparrow-wiki/features/back.md): Module back · Configuration features/back.yaml
- [Random teleport](https://nanamoserver.github.io/sparrow-wiki/features/rtp.md): Module rtp · Configuration features/rtp.yml
- [Spawn](https://nanamoserver.github.io/sparrow-wiki/features/spawn.md): Module spawn · Configuration features/spawn.yml
- [Warps](https://nanamoserver.github.io/sparrow-wiki/features/warp.md): Module warp · Configuration features/warp.yml
- [Homes](https://nanamoserver.github.io/sparrow-wiki/features/home.md): Module home · Configuration features/home.yml
- [Multi-currency economy](https://nanamoserver.github.io/sparrow-wiki/features/economy.md): Set economy: true in modules.yml and restart. Use /money or /coins for coins and /points for points. Each wallet starts at zero for each currency.
- [Teleport requests](https://nanamoserver.github.io/sparrow-wiki/features/tpa.md): Module tpa · Configuration features/tpa.yml

## Teleport configuration

- [Teleport options](https://nanamoserver.github.io/sparrow-wiki/teleport/overview.md): Cooldowns, warmups and arrival effects are configured in each feature's own file. For example, in features/home.yml:
- [Landing rules](https://nanamoserver.github.io/sparrow-wiki/teleport/processors.md): Each feature defines how it chooses a landing position.

## API usage

- [Teleport API](https://nanamoserver.github.io/sparrow-wiki/api/teleport.md)
- [Waypoint API](https://nanamoserver.github.io/sparrow-wiki/api/waypoint.md): A waypoint shows one local player a marker for a target. The viewer sees the marker, the target is the real location, and the anchor is where the marker is drawn. A distant target can have an anchor close to the viewer. Arrival checks and distance labels still use the real target.
- [Highlight API](https://nanamoserver.github.io/sparrow-wiki/api/highlight.md): Use net.momirealms.sparrow.service.highlight.Highlight to show block outlines to local players. The service starts with Sparrow and remains available when the command is disabled.
- [Economy API](https://nanamoserver.github.io/sparrow-wiki/api/economy.md): The examples use a quest reward and a chest shop. Add your server’s Sparrow build as a compile-only dependency and declare Sparrow as a server dependency so it loads first. The variables playerId, buyer and seller are player UUIDs.
